item.name: Owner adds approved leave on behalf

exec: pm.test('counts from server', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().counts).to.eql({ pending: 0, approved: 2, rejected: 1, all: 3 }))

item.name: 6. Payroll
item.description: Owner only. Uses last month (IST) so it can be finalized. Employees above joined 2026-04-01.

exec: pm.test('a draft row per employee', () => { pm.expect(body.rows.length).to.eql(2); body.rows.forEach((r) => pm.expect(r.status).to.eql('draft')) })
pm.test('totals computed by server', () => pm.expect(body.totals.netPaise).to.eql(body.rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.snapshot.netPaise, 0)))
pm.test('paid row stays paid', () => pm.expect(rows.find((r) => r._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('payrollId')).status).to.eql('paid'))
pm.test('other row back to draft', () => pm.expect(rows.find((r) => r._id === pm.collectionVariables.get('payrollId2')).status).to.eql('draft'))
pm.test('finalize, reopen, mark paid, adjust logged', () => ['payroll.finalize', 'payroll.reopen', 'payroll.mark_paid', 'payroll.adjust'].forEach((a) => pm.expect(actions).to.include(a)))
